text: 你看见一个发光的僵尸。
source_text: 你看见一个发光的僵尸。

text: A dirt nap will be given if alterations are made. Last one here tried.
source_text: A dirt nap will be given if alterations are made. Last one here tried.

text: 如果发生改变的话就会出些小纰漏。上一个人已经试过了。

text: The flow ends. So does your life.
source_text: The flow ends. So does your life.

text: 水流停止了流动，你的生命也一样。
